Chapter 223: Chapter 16 Identity Revealed (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan followed his eldest senior brother, step by step, walking inside the space tunnel.

With each step he took, Lin Yuan vaguely sensed that he had traversed an immense distance, all crammed into just a few steps due to some form of compression within the space tunnel, compressing ten light years or even dozens of light years into a matter of steps.

Lin Yuan had done some research on space rules as well, and the giant cube within the Seven Stars Void World, representing a spatial evolutionary path beyond the Sixth Rank, had already been fully understood by Lin Yuan up to the Seventh Rank Chapter.

However, compared to the profound mysteries of the space rules he was encountering now, it was like comparing the light of a firefly to the bright moon.

Quickly.

After merely taking ‘a few’ dozen steps.

...

Lin Yuan had moved to the other side of the space tunnel.

A planet appeared in the distance, hundreds to hundreds of times larger than Canglan Star.

“That is the Chikun Main Star.”

A smile appeared on his eldest senior brother’s face.

Not until this moment did his eldest senior brother feel that he and his junior brother were completely safe.

Even if a High-Rank Evolver at the peak of the Eighth Layer came attacking now, they were so close to Chikun Main Star that the Chikun Star Lord could intervene instantly.

“So many powerful beings.”

Lin Yuan faintly sensed that on Chikun Main Star, numerous High-Rank Evolver auras were lurking, and Sixth Rank Fallen Star Warriors were no longer rare on Chikun Main Star.

“I have already stepped into the Sixth Rank, my soul has achieved perfect harmony and transformation, and merged with the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path.”

“Even someone as powerful as my teacher cannot see through which evolutionary path I have cultivated.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

After becoming one of the thirteen Peak Masters of the Red Kun Lineage, Lin Yuan had been reluctant to return to Chikun Main Star.

He was worried that his cultivation of the Martial Tao Evolutionary Path would be seen through by other High-Rank Evolvers.

You see, the potential revealed by the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had the prospects of advancing to the Eighth Layer Evolutionary Path.

As the founder of this evolutionary path, Lin Yuan was, in a sense, an ‘Embryo’ of a great Evolution Scholar.

This identity far surpassed being one of the thirteen Peak Masters of the Red Kun lineage because any Evolution Scholar represents the true foundation of Human Civilization.

And an Evolution Scholar starts at the Eighth Layer, with a citizenship level that is unimaginably high, and their influence is much greater than that of a singular powerful Evolver.

“Follow me.”

The eldest senior brother’s mind slightly shifted.

The space around subtly distorted.

It isolated their appearances and auras.

Whoosh.

The eldest senior brother, with Lin Yuan, entered Chikun Main Star.

During this time, countless fluctuations transmitted as if confirming their identities and permissions.

Quickly.

The two soon arrived at the continent formed by more than a dozen mountains at the center of the planet.

Lin Yuan looked around, and there were a total of fourteen mountains, with the largest central peak belonging to the Chikun Star Lord.

The other thirteen mountains were those of Lin Yuan and the other twelve Peak Masters.

While walking, the eldest senior brother said, “Now that Junior Brother has come to the main star, next, our Red Kun lineage will update the information of the thirteen Peak Masters.”

“Junior Brother is from Canglan Star, and since Canglan Star is a Life Planet in the Dawn Star System, the Red Kun lineage will first announce it to the Dawn Star System, then spread it outwards from Chenxi Mainstar.”

“Okay,” Lin Yuan nodded.

Having reached the Sixth Rank, he could fully withstand the identity of one of the Red Kun lineage’s thirteen Peak Masters without facing an ‘unworthy of position’ issue.

Apart from the eldest senior brother, the second and third senior brothers, the rest of the senior brothers were also Sixth Rank.

Back when the Chikun Star Lord seized the body of a Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, he only dared to return to the Human Civilization Alliance after painstakingly reaching the Seventh Rank.

That’s because the Chikun Star Lord was not a genius in the conventional sense. The young Starry Sky Wanderer Kun that he possessed easily attracted animosity.

For example, the ‘parents’ of the original Starry Sky Wanderer Kun?

Or the special life group of the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun?

The Starry Sky Wanderer Kun species is indeed rare, but there are some, and with strong bloodlines, the probability of birthing powerful beings is much higher.

It was precisely because of this.

Chikun Star Lord hid until he reached the Seventh Rank before daring to show himself and return to Human Civilization.

“I wonder how Chenxi will feel, knowing that his star system has birthed such a supreme genius as Junior Brother,” said the eldest senior brother with a bit of emotion in his voice.

As one of the thirteen Peak Masters of the Red Kun lineage, Lin Yuan truly held the power of life and death over a Star Domain.

Coming from the Dawn Star System, Lin Yuan was likely to develop some fondness for it.

This fondness might not be substantial, but compared to completely unfamiliar star systems, he would definitely lean toward the Dawn Star System.

Under such conditions, as long as the Dawn Star System didn’t sabotage itself, it was equivalent to having a supporter in the Chikun Star Domain, thereby increasing its influence.

This was just the impact Lin Yuan made on the vast Dawn Star System; but for Canglan Star… If Lin Yuan wished, Canglan Star could even advance to a Higher-grade Life Planet.

From a Middle-grade Life Planet to a Higher-grade Life Planet… This involves various aspects like the level of cosmic energy a planet can accommodate, the number of powerful beings, etc.

Normally, Higher-grade Life Planets are mostly innate; few Middle-grade Life Planets advance to Higher-grade Life Planets.

Because the costs involved in such an upgrade are too great.

But with the tacit support of Lin Yuan, the Peak Master of the thirteen peaks, the ascent of Canglan Star to a Higher-grade Life Planet is just a matter of time.

“Big Senior Brother, shall we go see the teacher now?” Lin Yuan asked.

“See the teacher?”

The eldest senior brother shook his head: “There’s no need.”

“When you entered Chikun Main Star, the teacher already knew, seeing or not seeing doesn’t matter,” said the eldest senior brother, looking at Lin Yuan with a somewhat solemn expression, “Junior Brother, the most important thing for you now is not to see the teacher, nor is it to continue cultivating.”

“Rather…

“It’s to form an imprint of your Life Essence and then brand it into the universe.”
